g.text: Capability-gated bridge from constraint theories to symbolic automata
Bounded search proves Sat only with a rechecked witness.
Search exhaustion without completeness yields DontKnow.
Empty label streams, bounded exhaustion, and solver
silence are not exactness witnesses. The explicit
decide_exact contract is the classical admission gate.
exact decidability capability and Boolean bridge (green)
incomplete solver path excluded from classical use (red)
